math-race — unofficial port of iloire/math-race (MIT, archived 2024-02-28).

upstream: https://github.com/iloire/math-race
commit:   3c4b2fa4e17457b9eff8f0e534e54e5658e4a5d8  (master)
date:     2012 (archived 2024-02-28)
license:  MIT (COPYING-math-race.txt)  Copyright (c) 2012 Iván Loire

What we took:
  lib/modules/race.js  Operation() — two integers 0–20, '+' or '−',
                       first correct answer scores, clock is the server,
                       next equation as soon as someone scores.
  config.js            duration (the README said 60s; config shipped 30s).
  LICENSE-MIT          packed inside the GIF as COPYING-math-race.txt.

NOT copied (and not loaded):
  server.js / app.js / socket.io  — the Node process was the starter pistol
  knockout-2.0.0.js / jquery      — classic scripts instead
  Bootstrap / bootswatch themes   — dark phone-first CSS instead
  views/index.html                — rewritten; Invite is OS chrome

GifOS has no game server. The host (lowest live id) is the clock and the
only writer of the shared match row. Players publish an answer; the host
awards the point if it is first and correct.

Easy difficulty is the original generator. Medium (×) and Hard (mixed)
are additions so a round is still a race when +/− gets too easy.

The MIT notice travels INSIDE the GIF as COPYING-math-race.txt as well as here.
